user.title: Configure XGIMI projector
user.description: Enter the projector network details and choose an initial wake backend. The token is used only for BLE wake-up.

data_description.token: Hexadecimal manufacturer-data value from key 70; do not include the key itself.
data_description.wake_backend: Automatic prefers a configured ESP32 wake button, then tries a local advertising-capable Bluetooth adapter.

auto.title: Configure automatic wake
auto.description: If an ESP32 wake button is selected, it will be preferred. Otherwise, a local advertising-capable Bluetooth adapter will be used.

data_description.esp32_wake_entity: Optional ESPHome button that transmits the XGIMI advertisement.
data_description.bluetooth_adapter: Only local BlueZ adapters with BLE advertising support are listed.

local.title: Configure local Bluetooth wake
local.description: Use the Home Assistant host's BlueZ service and system D-Bus. Home Assistant Container must mount /run/dbus and have suitable Bluetooth capabilities.

data_description.bluetooth_adapter: Only local BlueZ adapters with BLE advertising support are listed.

esp32.title: Configure ESP32 wake
esp32.description: Select a dedicated ESPHome button that sends the XGIMI advertisement. A stock ESPHome Bluetooth Proxy cannot send arbitrary BLE advertisements.

data_description.esp32_wake_entity: The button must be provided by custom ESPHome firmware configured with this projector's token.

error.entity_missing: The selected button entity does not exist.
error.entity_unsupported: The ESP32 wake entity must be a button entity.
error.invalid_host: The hostname or IP address is invalid.
error.invalid_token: The token must be 1–16 bytes of hexadecimal data.

init.title: Wake backend
init.description: Choose how Home Assistant should transmit the BLE wake advertisement.

auto.title: Automatic wake
auto.description: If an ESP32 wake button is selected, it will be preferred. Otherwise, a local advertising-capable Bluetooth adapter will be used.

data_description.esp32_wake_entity: Optional ESPHome button that transmits the XGIMI advertisement.
data_description.bluetooth_adapter: Only local BlueZ adapters with BLE advertising support are listed.

local.title: Local Bluetooth wake
local.description: Use a local BlueZ adapter exposed through the host system D-Bus.

data_description.bluetooth_adapter: Only local BlueZ adapters with BLE advertising support are listed.

esp32.title: ESP32 wake
esp32.description: A stock ESPHome Bluetooth Proxy is not sufficient. Select the dedicated button exposed by custom XGIMI advertising firmware.

data_description.esp32_wake_entity: The button must transmit the device-specific XGIMI advertisement.

error.entity_missing: The selected button entity does not exist.
error.entity_unsupported: The ESP32 wake entity must be a button entity.

dbus_unavailable.title: System D-Bus is unavailable
dbus_unavailable.description: The local wake backend cannot connect to system D-Bus. For Home Assistant Container, run BlueZ on the Docker host, mount `/run/dbus:/run/dbus:ro`, and add `NET_ADMIN` and `NET_RAW`. Do not run a second bluetoothd in the container.

bluez_unavailable.title: The host BlueZ service is unavailable
bluez_unavailable.description: Start the host BlueZ service and verify that Home Assistant can access it through system D-Bus. Container installations need `/run/dbus:/run/dbus:ro`, `NET_ADMIN`, and `NET_RAW`.

no_local_adapter.title: No local advertising-capable Bluetooth adapter
no_local_adapter.description: No local Bluetooth adapter with BLE advertising support was found. Check Settings → Devices & services → Bluetooth. Container installations also need the host BlueZ service, `/run/dbus:/run/dbus:ro`, `NET_ADMIN`, and `NET_RAW`.

configured_adapter_missing.title: The configured Bluetooth adapter is missing
configured_adapter_missing.description: The selected local adapter is no longer present or no longer supports BLE advertising. Reconnect it, or choose Automatic or another adapter in the integration options.

esp32_entity_missing.title: The ESP32 wake button is missing
esp32_entity_missing.description: The selected ESPHome wake button is missing or unavailable. Check the ESP32 device, Wi-Fi connection, and ESPHome integration, then select the button again.

esp32_entity_unavailable.title: The ESP32 wake button is unavailable
esp32_entity_unavailable.description: The selected ESPHome wake button is missing or unavailable. Check the ESP32 device, Wi-Fi connection, and ESPHome integration.

no_backend_available.title: No XGIMI wake backend is available
no_backend_available.description: Configure a custom ESPHome XGIMI wake button, or connect a local Bluetooth adapter that supports BLE advertising. A stock ESPHome Bluetooth Proxy is not an advertising backend.

wake_backend_failure.title: The XGIMI wake backend failed
wake_backend_failure.description: The selected wake backend could not transmit the advertisement. Check the integration diagnostics and wake backend configuration.
